implementation.name: delete_task
implementation.pseudo_code:
FUNCTION delete_task(task_id):

    FILTER out task with task_id
    IF task was removed:
        SAVE updated tasks to DB
        RETURN True
    ELSE:
        RETURN False

implementation.How_is_it_connected_to_implementation: Handles the toggle complete action from TaskItem. Calls the API to update the task's completed status, reloads tasks to reflect changes in UI.
implementation.name: handleToggleComplete
implementation.pseudo_code:
FUNCTION handleToggleComplete(task):
    TRY
        CALL api.updateTask(task.id, { ...task, completed: !task.completed })
        CALL loadTasks() // refresh UI
    CATCH error
        SHOW alert('Failed to update task status')

implementation.name: update_task
implementation.pseudo_code:
LOAD all tasks from database
FOR each task in tasks:
    IF task.id == task_id:
        CREATE updated_task with new values
        REPLACE old task with updated_task
        SAVE tasks to database
        RETURN updated_task
IF no matching task:
    RETURN None
